OpenAI-Compatible Images 1.1.0 extends the Codex Plugin runtime to Windows, macOS, and Linux while preserving one platform-neutral package and an independent Standalone Skill.

## Highlights

- Runs the Codex Plugin on Windows, macOS, and Linux with platform-specific secure repository filesystem adapters.
- Selects `python` on Windows and `python3` on macOS/Linux, requires Python 3.12 or newer, and supports one explicit `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_IMAGEGEN_PYTHON` override.
- Accepts the macOS system `/var` alias to `/private/var` while continuing to reject project-owned symbolic links outside the safe repository path contract.
- Builds release candidates independently on Windows, Linux, and macOS and requires identical file sets and SHA-256 bytes before publication.
- Keeps the platform filesystem adapters and MCP runtime files out of the Standalone Skill archive.

## Install

Install the Codex Plugin from the Git-backed marketplace, or download the matching Plugin or Standalone archive together with `SHA256SUMS` from this Release. Verify the selected archive against `SHA256SUMS`, then follow the [v1.1.0 installation guide](https://github.com/Syh1906/openai-compatible-imagegen/blob/v1.1.0/docs/guides/installation.md).

The Codex Plugin requires Python 3.12 or newer. It selects `python` on Windows and `python3` on macOS/Linux. Set `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_IMAGEGEN_PYTHON` when the required interpreter uses another command or path.

## Known limitations

- macOS and Linux do not provide the Windows **Show in folder** action. Generation, editing, artifacts, annotations, and canvas workflows remain supported.
